verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh has case management for prioritising and reviewing alerts, and cases can be filtered by assignee and case stage, which implies assignment and staged workflow. Reviewers record case decisions, and a case audit-trail endpoint exists. Escalation is documented only as AI agents routing high-risk cases to human review, not as analyst-to-analyst escalation. Missing for 10: any SLA or due-date tracking, documented reviewer-to-senior escalation or approval chains, detail showing the audit trail captures who decided and the rationale, and hands-on corroboration.
